scope: Five pre-registered paper URLs for query rewriting, conversational QA and multi-query fusion; no source discovery was performed.

verified_claims: HyDE generates a hypothetical document from a query with an instruction-following language model, then embeds it with an unsupervised contrastive encoder and retrieves neighboring real documents.
The hypothetical document may contain false details; the dense bottleneck anchors retrieval to the real corpus rather than treating generated text as evidence.
The paper reports gains over unsupervised Contriever across web search, QA, fact verification and multilingual settings under its evaluated configurations.
records.boundary: Generated hypothetical text is not evidence. Results depend on the language model, encoder, corpus and task; the paper does not establish universal production gains.

verified_claims: Rewrite-Retrieve-Read places query rewriting before retrieval and reading, using an LLM-generated query to retrieve context.
It proposes a trainable small rewriter for a frozen retriever and black-box reader, trained with reader feedback through reinforcement learning.
The paper reports improvements on open-domain and multiple-choice QA in its experimental settings.
records.boundary: The reported gains depend on the paper's web-search, reader and training setup; rewrite drift, RL cost and latency require separate evaluation.

verified_claims: Step-Back Prompting first abstracts a concrete instance into a higher-level concept or first principle and uses it to guide subsequent reasoning.
The paper evaluates the method on STEM, knowledge QA and multi-hop reasoning with PaLM-2L, GPT-4 and Llama2-70B, reporting task-specific gains.
records.boundary: These are prompt and reasoning experiments, not universal retrieval guarantees. Abstraction can lose entities or exact constraints, so original-query constraints must be retained.

verified_claims: QReCC provides about 14K conversations and 80K QA pairs over 10M web pages and 54M passages.
The dataset supports separate question rewriting, passage retrieval and reading-comprehension evaluation as well as end-to-end conversational QA.
The paper reports a first baseline F1 of 19.10 versus a human upper bound of 75.45, illustrating task difficulty in its benchmark setting.
records.boundary: Dataset scale, web snapshot and baseline metrics are historical research settings and are not production quality thresholds.

verified_claims: RAG-Fusion generates multiple queries and combines their retrieved documents and scores with reciprocal rank fusion.
In the reported Infineon product-information case, manual evaluation found gains in answer accuracy, relevance and comprehensiveness from multi-perspective queries.
The paper notes that insufficiently related generated queries can lead to off-topic results.
records.boundary: This is a single enterprise scenario with manual evaluation and a revised preprint (v2). It does not prove universal superiority over one query; preserve the original query and evaluate drift, cost and latency.
